name: Certificates
description: One row per product certificate (CE/FCC/RoHS/UN38.3/UKCA/Other): issuer, certificate number, issued/expiry dates, the certificate file itself, and a source note. There is no stored status field -- expiring_soon/expired/valid is always derived client-side from expiry-date vs now, the same derived-not-stored pattern as this app's own SLA/status badges (see product-hub-model.js's certStatusFor).

agentPrompts.label: What certificates are expiring soon?
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-product-hub` skill in this folder, then list certificates that are expired or expiring within 90 days, soonest first, with the product each belongs to.

agentPrompts.label: Record a new or renewed certificate
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-product-hub` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then record the certificate I describe (type, issuer, certificate number, issued/expiry dates, file, and a source note citing the specific document and page/section) for the product I name. Never invent an expiry date or issuer — mark it missing and request evidence instead.
